answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit locked to a single hardware-verified key before it can earn: creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital, and the stake is slashed when duplicate signing is detected. A trust score climbs only through sustained honest attestations, so a newcomer cannot reach the zenith of the reward curve by cloning itself; the ridge between a fresh account and a trusted one is paid work over time, and the deposit anchors every identity to one accountable key.
